title: DEVLO AIOS
description: A governed operations system for agent-assisted business work, research, SEO checks, task routing, and source-backed decision records.
body:
DEVLO AIOS is an operations system for agent-assisted business work. It is not a single chat prompt or one automation. It is a working structure for turning research, tasks, checks, decisions, and reports into a process that can be reviewed.

The project is useful because agent work can become messy fast. Agents can make claims without sources, skip a handoff, repeat old work, or mark something done before it is verified. DEVLO AIOS adds structure around that: intake, task records, source-backed reports, status gates, and review steps.

## What it does

- Keeps business operations work organized across tasks, reports, and decisions.
- Tracks tool and model changes so the system can react when agent tools improve or break.
- Supports source-backed research and run cards for business execution.
- Adds gates around SEO, GEO, website-copy feedback, and outreach workflows.
- Records decisions in a way that can be checked later.
- Helps turn repeated agent work into a managed process instead of a loose chat history.

## Recent work

The June work focused on governance and feedback loops. The system gained stronger source-backed run card intake, Fable-governed business execution, LLM skill gates, SEO and GEO workflow hardening, multi-site Search Console export support, and public website copy feedback gates.

There was also steady work on model-watch and tool-watch reporting. Those reports matter because agent systems depend on changing tools. If a model changes behavior or a tool becomes available, the operating process should notice and adapt. The task registry automation also became cleaner, with isolated automation branches and generated task records.

## Value for users

The value is safer agent work. A user gets a system that asks for evidence, keeps records, and makes it harder for an agent to skip verification. That is especially helpful for research, SEO, operations, and client-adjacent work where a wrong claim can waste time.

## Current direction

The current direction is a more dependable operating layer. The system should keep making agent work easier to inspect: what was asked, what sources were used, what changed, what still needs review, and what can be safely repeated.

## Public boundary

The public page only describes the operating pattern. It does not publish private client data, lead lists, reports, credentials, internal spreadsheets, or confidential task details.
